# Third-party software

[Home](../README.md) · [Shared license texts](Common/README.md) · [Distribution guidance](../DISTRIBUTION.md)

Browse a component, then select its version to read the original notices and find upstream sources. Some packages include multiple components with different licenses.

This reference covers 252 package releases across 192 package names, plus Python runtime references. It includes optional SDK and platform dependencies; it is not an installed-system inventory or a guarantee about future releases. Snapshot: 24 October 2026.
